test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange to form a meaningful paragraph:
(1) The teacher entered the class.
(2) The students greeted her.
(3) She smiled at them and replied.
(4) The lesson began.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sequence follows the logical progression of events in the classroom.
 
• **Sentence 1:** "The teacher entered the class" introduces the main character and sets the scene.
 
• **Sentence 2:** "The students greeted her" logically follows as a response to the teacher’s entry.
 
• **Sentence 3:** "She smiled at them and replied" is a natural continuation of the interaction between the teacher and students.
 
• **Sentence 4:** "The lesson began" concludes the sequence with the teacher starting the lesson after the initial interaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Logical arrangement of sentences is crucial to maintain coherence and clarity in a paragraph.
 
• When arranging sentences, start with the sentence that introduces the setting or main character, followed by actions or responses in chronological order.

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:**

"The teacher entered the class. The students greeted her. She smiled at them and replied. The lesson began."
